subject: Model fit follow-up: recommended models, benchmarks, and parity thresholds
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: jordan.ellis@paygrid.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Model fit follow-up: recommended models, benchmarks, and parity thresholds

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call earlier, really appreciated the context on PayGrid's payments reconciliation workflows and the hard latency/cost constraints for real-time customer support. Quick recap + recommended next steps so we have a shared plan: 

1) Recap of goals
- Accuracy on intent+entity extraction >= parity with your current proprietary baseline (you mentioned ~95% intent accuracy on the test set)
- 75-150ms 95th p latency target for short chat context (80-120 tokens)
- Keep token cost under your current per-conversation budget if possible

2) Initial model candidates we recommend you evaluate (open models that historically match well on similar tabular+NL tasks):
- Llama 3 13B (8-bit quantized): strong balance for instruction-following + cost; often gets close to proprietary baselines when prompt + few-shot evals are tuned
- Mistral-Instruct 7B: very competitive on instruction tasks with lower latency/cost; good for throughputs where sub-100ms matters
- Redmond-open-70B-quant (our curated 70B variant): higher quality headroom for tricky edge cases, useful as a fallback for hard cases

3) Parity & acceptance thresholds (what we recommend to move forward):
- Primary metric: intent F1 >= 0.95 of your proprietary baseline (we can compute relative parity rather than absolute)
- Secondary metrics: entity extraction F1 within 3 points; end-to-end QA/response appropriateness win-rate >= 90% vs baseline per prompt set
- Latency: 95th percentile within your SLO or cost-aware tradeoffs documented in the benchmark CSV

4) Deliverables we will provide this week
- Prompt set v1 (attached): canonical prompts and slot-filling examples used for PayGrid evals
- Benchmark run summary (attached): preliminary runs on the candidate models with sequence lengths reflecting your usage
- Parity thresholds doc (attached): suggested pass/fail rules we can adjust together

5) Immediate asks from your side
- Share a 1-2k example production sample (anonymized) or confirm we should use the synthetic seed set in the Drive link below
- Confirm which metrics you care most about (intent vs entity vs latency) so we can prioritize runs

Next steps
- If you're good with the plan, we'll run 1) a full eval on the seed prompts against the three candidate models, 2) a short A/B set where we route 10% of traffic to the best open-model candidate for a week.
- Timeline: 5 business days for the first eval pass once we have the sample or sign-off on the seed set.

Attaching the prompt set + benchmark CSV. I'll follow up with pricing/latency tradeoffs from our Dedicated pools if that ends up being needed.

Thanks, talk soon.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: PayGrid_model_eval_prompt_set_v1.json (prompt set), redwood_benchmarks_paygrid_q2_2027.csv (benchmark summary), canonical_parity_thresholds.md (pass/fail guide)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@paygrid.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.shah@paygrid.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model fit follow-up: recommended models, benchmarks, and parity thresholds

Thanks Lauren, this is great, and exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick items from our side: 

- We can provide an anonymized 1,200-example seed set by end of day Monday (PII scrubbed).
- Priorities: intent accuracy first, then entity extraction. Latency is negotiable but we'd prefer to stay under 150ms 95th p for agent-side responses.
- Can you include a quick note on cost delta vs our current baseline? Even a ballpark $/1000 tokens for the Llama 3 13B vs our proprietary infra would help for internal approvals.

Also, curious whether you expect any quality regressions in the open models on our fraud-detection prompts (there are a few edge prompts that current model handles with custom rules). Would you recommend the 70B fallback for those?

Happy to sync Tuesday if you want to walk through the attachments.

Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Head of Product, PayGrid
jordan.ellis@paygrid.com

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: jordan.ellis@paygrid.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model fit follow-up: recommended models, benchmarks, and parity thresholds

Thanks Jordan, appreciate the quick turnaround. A few answers inline + updated asks: 

- Seed set: perfect, that will unlock the 5-day eval timeline. Please drop the anonymized file into the Drive folder (link below) or reply with a secure transfer link.

- Cost: Rough ballparks (hosted, inference token cost):
  - Llama 3 13B (8-bit quant): ~$1.10 / 1k input+output tokens (subject to volume tiers)
  - Mistral-Instruct 7B: ~$0.55 / 1k tokens
  - Redmond-open-70B-quant (fallback): ~$3.00 / 1k tokens
  - Dedicated reserved pricing will be lower at scale; we'll provide detailed committed quotes if you want to pursue Dedicated pools.

- Fraud edge cases: there is some risk of regressions on highly engineered rule-based behavior. Our recommendation:
  1) Run the 70B quant as an offline fallback for flagged edge prompts (cost only incurred for a small % of cases).
  2) Add a small set of guardrail prompts in the prompt set that replicate the problematic rule behaviors - we included a few examples in the prompt set attachment.

Next steps (we suggest):
- You upload the anonymized sample to the Drive folder by Mon EOD -> we run the first round of evals across the three candidate models (5 business days)
- We share a results CSV + pass/fail table against the parity thresholds
- Optional: short A/B with 10% traffic to the top open-model candidate for a week (we'll help instrument metrics)

I've summarized costs and a proposed run cadence in the attached benchmark CSV. Let us know if you'd prefer a short call Tuesday to align.

Best,
Lauren

Attachments: same as before

Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-paygrid-evals
